title: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL): Seamless State Handoff to Omni-Channel

steps.prompt: When an Agentforce agent detects an emotionally distressed or angry customer requiring escalation, what is the Well-Architected handoff sequence?

options.label: Route via Omni-Channel, passing a synthesized conversation summary and structured intent payload to the human agent
options.rationale: Escalate via Omni-Channel routing, passing a synthesized conversation summary and structured intent payload so the human agent has instant context without customer repetition.

options.label: Transfer the raw uncompressed chat history directly to a standard support queue without context summarization
options.distractorAntipattern: Dumping dozens of raw chat turns forces the human agent to read long transcripts while the frustrated customer waits.
options.rationale: Transferring unsummarized chat transcripts delays live agent response time, increases customer hold duration, and leads to repeated customer questions.

options.label: Create an escalated Case record in Salesforce and instruct the customer to disconnect and await a callback within 24h
options.distractorAntipattern: Terminating synchronous live engagement when a customer is distressed severely damages customer satisfaction.
options.rationale: Terminating an active live interaction to force an asynchronous channel switch creates severe customer friction and violates Well-Architected experience principles.
